steps.title: COUNT per customer_id
steps.prompt:
GROUP BY bundles rows into piles that share the same customer_id.
Then count(*) works on each pile.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM sales GROUP BY customer_id;
hints: Start with SELECT customer_id, count(*).
FROM sales.
Finish with GROUP BY customer_id.
Write: SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM sales GROUP BY customer_id;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM sales GROUP BY customer_id;
steps.memory_trick: GROUP BY = one output row per pile.
